battle.name: 寧陵之戰
battle.brief: 至德元年（756）秋冬，安史叛軍大將尹子奇圍睢陽，寧陵在宋州之西，為官軍援軍與糧道的屏蔽，雙方在此反覆爭奪。卡面埃及月牙劍不見於本役：其外彎單刃、砍下不拔的刀性，於唐代直刃環首唐刀並無對應；本役真正分勝負的，是城頭弓弩、填壕雲梯與撞車，和睢陽守軍一年的死守。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 寧陵之戰屬安史之亂中河南道的戰事，交戰雙方是唐廷與安史叛軍。唐一方的指揮體系，以玄宗、肅宗兩朝的中樞為樞紐：至德元年（756）玄宗出奔成都，皇太子李亨即位靈武，是為肅宗，詔令河北、河南、關中、江淮諸道節度使就地募兵自保，州縣長吏各自團練，朝廷的軍令要繞過層層節度使才落到縣城。睢陽守軍即此體系的末端節點，張巡以清池、陳留之吏材兼領宋州軍民事，兵不多而權柄重；郭子儀以朔方節度使統河東精兵，屯兵河中，是朝廷在東都之外唯一握有重兵的樞紐。安史一方則以安祿山、范陽三鎮為根基，755年自稱大燕皇帝，其部眾以范陽、幽州、河東的蕃漢兵為主，騎兵份量極重，尹子奇受命為河南大將，總眾於東都之東。寧陵在宋州之西，是叛軍西進睢陽、官軍由汴陳一線北上時的必爭之地，故此役在編制上是唐廷的州縣守軍與叛軍大軍在河南道的一次對撞，而不是兩個國家之間的國戰。
countriesEn: Ningling belongs to the fighting in Henan Circuit during the An Lushan rebellion, and the two belligerents were the Tang court and the rebel army of An Lushan. On the Tang side the chain of command ran through the central secretariat of the Xuanzong and Suzong reigns: in 756 Xuanzong fled to Chengdu, and the crown prince Li Heng took the throne at Lingwu as Suzong, after which edicts ordered the military governors of Hebei, Henan, Guanzhong and Jianghuai to raise troops where they stood and hold what they had, leaving district magistrates to form their own local militia. Orders from the centre had to pass through the provincial governors before they reached a county town. The garrison of Suiyang was the far end of that chain: Zhang Xun, who had been magistrate of Qingchi and of Chenliu, took charge of the Songzhou command with few men but real authority, while Guo Ziyi, military governor of Shuofang, mustered the picked troops of Hedong at Hezhong and was the one hinge of heavy Tang power west of the Eastern Capital. The rebel side rested on An Lushan and the three Fanyang commands: in 755 he proclaimed himself emperor of Great Yan, his ranks were drawn from Fan-Yang, Youzhou and Hedong, Chinese and foreign, with a very heavy share of cavalry, and Yin Ziqi was appointed commander of the rebel forces in Henan to mass them east of the Eastern Capital. Ningling lies west of Songzhou, on the road the rebel advance on Suiyang and the Tang relief columns coming up from Bian and Chenli both had to cross, which makes this engagement an impact between a Tang district garrison and a rebel field army inside Henan Circuit rather than a war between two sovereign states.
people: 史籍關於寧陵一線的具體指揮者記載有限，可確定的人物主要來自三方。唐方以睢陽守將張巡為樞紐：張巡蒲州人，進士出身，先任清池令、陳留令，叛軍逼近時起兵據雍丘，屢挫賊眾，兵勢漸集，遂領宋州睢陽城；同守睢陽的許遠、南霽雲、雷萬春等皆其部曲，南霽雲曾突圍往徐州向淮南道求援，未得大兵而還。叛軍主帥尹子奇自洛陽方向驕兵而至，屢攻不下，乃轉為分兵斷援與奪糧。朝廷方面，肅宗在靈武即位後以郭子儀為副元帥節制河北諸道，詔各道發兵赴援；郭子儀收兵河中，蓄勢於東都以西，與睢陽守軍形成南北兩面之呼應。叛軍方面的將佐，傳記多繫於睢陽之役，可見董千里、李歸仁、蔡文景、許若陸等姓名，多為河洛河北降人，尹子奇以之為攻城主力和分兵斷援的骨幹。須說明的是，寧陵城本身的守將與指揮官，舊唐書、資治通鑑與地方志均未留下清晰記載，諸說並存，寧可存疑，不可臆造。
peopleEn: The surviving record is thin on the commanders actually engaged at Ningling, but the principal figures can be fixed from three sides. For the Tang the pivot was Zhang Xun, who held Suiyang: a native of Puzhou and a metropolitan graduate, he had served as magistrate of Qingchi and then of Chenliu, and when the rebels closed in he raised troops at Yongqiu, beat them repeatedly, gathered a small force, and was then given command of Suiyang in Songzhou. Xu Yuan, Nan Jiyun and Lei Wanchun served with him, and Nan Jiyun once broke out to Xuzhou to beg aid from the Huainan circuit, returning without a relief army. The rebel commander Yin Ziqi came on from the direction of Luoyang with a host that could not take the city by storm, and turned instead to cutting relief columns and seizing supplies. On the court side, Suzong, enthroned at Lingwu, appointed Guo Ziyi deputy commander-in-chief over the northern circuits and called on every circuit to send troops; Guo recovered Hezhong, husbanded his strength west of the Eastern Capital, and answered the Suiyang garrison from the south. It must be said that the Tang officer who actually commanded at Ningling is nowhere clearly recorded in the Old Book of Tang, the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, or the local gazetteers; the accounts differ, and it is better to leave the question open than to invent a name.
kits: 卡面兵器是埃及月牙劍（Khopesh），約公元前1500年前後的埃及新王國中期器物：弧形單刃，刃口開於外弧，握柄藏於內弧，形如一把小斧加上鐮刀形刃；早期多見青銅製品，晚期新王國改用鐵質，考古所得多屬儀仗或近身格鬥之器，總長約半米上下，其設計要義正是砍下去不必拔出。本役戰場在河南道，與之毫無瓜葛：唐代官軍與叛軍的冷兵器是直刃環首唐刀，長刀配長柄、長於劈砍與推刺，短刀與匕首藏於腰際，劍已退居儀飾與象徵；火力核心則在弓與弩，攻城一方備雲梯、撞車、飛樓與火箭，防守一方靠城頭弩砲、拒馬與鹿角寨消耗來敵。寧陵與睢陽一帶以土築城垣加壕溝為防，車隊負責運糧，人力與畜力構成後勤主幹。弩分蹶張與臂力兩式，蹶張者足踏而發，臂力者上架而發，攻城與守城各有取舍；至德年間的強弩與硬弓已是州縣守軍常備之物。戰場上真正與月牙劍功能最接近者，是叛軍騎兵腰間的短刀：皆為單刃，皆為貼身廝鬥而設。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Egyptian khopesh, an artefact of about 1500 BCE from the middle of the New Kingdom: a single-edged curved blade with the edge on the outside of the arc and the grip tucked into the inner curve, shaped like a small axe with a sickle-shaped edge. Early examples are usually bronze and later New Kingdom ones iron; most excavated pieces are ceremonial or close-quarter weapons barely half a metre long, and the whole point of the design is a cut that does not need to be withdrawn. The battlefield here lay in Henan Circuit and had nothing to do with it. The cold weapons of the Tang official and rebel armies were straight single-edged ring-pommel sabres: long blades with long grips for cutting and thrusting, short knives and daggers carried at the waist, while the sword had retreated to dress and symbolism. The real weight of firepower lay with the bow and the crossbow; besiegers brought scaling ladders, battering rams, siege towers and fire-arrows, and the defended relied on crossbows on the wall, spiked chevaux-de-frise and deer-horn palisades to wear the attackers down. At Ningling and Suiyang the defences were rammed-earth walls with a ditch beyond them, carts carried the grain, and human and animal labour made up the bulk of the logistics. The closest functional equivalent of the khopesh on the field was the short knife at the rebel cavalryman's belt: single-edged, and made for the same close-quarters work.
tactics: 睢陽一役的戰術樣板，正是寧陵方向爭奪的底本。叛軍攻城採分番輪進：先以步卒填壕、砍伐鹿角，再扛雲梯、撞車逼近，數十番疊攻，士卒屍積成階；守軍於城頭以弩矢壓制梯上人，以撞木擊毀撞車，以火箭焚燒梯幕，遇敵退則開門出擊，以精騎夜襲營壘。叛軍並不強攻到底，而是分兵十面埋伏，截斷從汴州、陳留、徐州方向趕來的援軍；每番進攻先鳴鼓噪而後壓上，攻城器械多自幽州、范陽運來，並拆屋取材以充撞木；寧陵恰在睢陽西北、通汴陳與徐泗的孔道上，斷此一線，即斷睢陽外援。城內糧盡，士卒羅雀掘鼠以食，援兵不至而圍城不解。史載有限，寧陵方面究竟屬攻城被攻，還是野戰攔截，諸說並存；但可以確定的是，整場睢陽戰役是一場以城防消耗戰術主導的持久戰，而非一次野戰決鬥。
tacticsEn: The tactical pattern of the Suiyang fighting is the template for the struggle along the Ningling line. The rebels attacked in relays: infantry filled the ditch and cut the deer-horn barricades, then men carried up scaling ladders and battering rams, pressing in over dozens of successive assaults with the fallen trodden into a ramp. The garrison answered with crossbow fire from the wall, with beams dropped to smash the rams, and with fire-arrows to burn the ladder screens, opening the gates to strike out with cavalry on night raids when the enemy fell back. The rebels did not simply batter the walls to the end; they spread out to lie in ambush on ten sides and cut off the relief columns coming from Bianzhou, Chenliu and Xuzhou. Ningling stands on exactly that road northwest of Suiyang, the corridor to Bian-Chen and Xu-Si, and closing it closed Suiyang's outside support. Inside the city the grain ran out, soldiers netted sparrows and dug out mice to eat, and the siege was not lifted. The record is thin on whether the fighting at Ningling was a siege or a field interception, for the accounts differ; but what can be fixed is this: the whole Suiyang campaign was a protracted war of attrition fought from a fortified position, not a single field engagement.
data: 可引的數字多出於舊唐書、資治通鑑一系，且多屬通行的約數。睢陽守軍，史料記張巡與許遠合兵六千八百人；叛軍尹子奇眾十餘萬，通鑑稱十三萬，另有十萬之說，諸說並存。圍城自天寶十五載（756）秋延至至德二載（757）冬，前後逾十個月；張巡屢出城反擊，兩書所記斬獲多以數千計，亦有更小之數。城陷之日，張巡、許遠、南霽雲等三十六人同殉，餘眾大部隨城而降。距寧陵至睢陽約三十餘里，一說四十里；睢陽至汴州約二百餘里，至洛陽約五百餘里；睢陽城垣周約十里，高數丈，壕闊數尺，環城植木謂之鹿角。張巡先後出城迎賊數十次，兩書雖不載每次斬獲，其出戰之頻仍可作為此役消耗程度的旁證。以上距離與城制，參河南地方志與唐宋職方、輿地紀要一類記載，個別數字仍有出入，不宜當作精確值引用。
dataEn: The figures that can be quoted come mostly from the Old Book of Tang and the Comprehensive Mirror, and most of them are round numbers. The Suiyang garrison is recorded as six thousand eight hundred men under Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan. Yin Ziqi's host is given as more than a hundred thousand, thirteen thousand in the Mirror, with a figure of one hundred thousand also current; the accounts differ. The siege ran from the autumn of 756 to the winter of 757, over ten months. Zhang Xun sallied out repeatedly, and both books put his kills at several thousand apiece, though smaller numbers are also given. On the day the city fell, Zhang Xun, Xu Yuan, Nan Jiyun and thirty-four others were killed in the breach, and most of the remainder surrendered. Ningling lies about thirty li from Suiyang, one account saying forty; Suiyang is about two hundred and some li from Bianzhou and roughly five hundred from Luoyang; the circuit of the Suiyang wall is given as about ten li, several zhang high, with a ditch several chi wide and wooden deer-horn defences planted round the base. These distances and dimensions come from the local gazetteers of Henan and from Tang and Song administrative geography; individual numbers still vary and should not be cited as exact.
cause: 寧陵之戰的起因要從安史之亂的整體推演。安祿山以誅楊國忠為名於范陽起兵，兩月而陷洛陽，河北道望風瓦解，河東、河南兩道郡縣或降或散，唐廷在中原腹地只剩睢陽一座孤城。叛軍拿下東都固然得了宮室府庫，但江淮九道的租庸仍要由運河北運，汴水一線不通，江淮的糧就到不了中原戰場；睢陽扼宋州、當汴陳通道，正是卡在運河與汴水轉運的咽喉上。守住睢陽，叛軍就難以切斷唐廷的江南財賦；拿下睢陽，則可西掃汴陳、南窺徐州。因此尹子奇傾力攻睢陽，寧陵作為其西面屏障與官軍援軍的門戶，自然成為必爭之地。至德元年秋，陳留、汴州一帶州縣多淪於賊手，官軍在河南道已無成建制的野戰兵力可恃，只剩各城自守與節度使的零星部兵。朝廷一方則因玄宗西幸、諸道節度使各自擁兵而觀望，遠方援兵久不至，才逼得睢陽以孤軍當強敵。
causeEn: The origins of the fighting at Ningling have to be read out of the larger An Lushan rebellion. An Lushan rose in Fanyang under the pretext of punishing Yang Guozhong, took Luoyang within two months, and Hebei dissolved at a word; in the middle belt the Tang court was left with the single city of Suiyang. Holding Luoyang gave the rebels the palace and the treasury, but the land tax of the nine circuits of Jianghuai still travelled north by canal, and while the Bian river route stayed open those taxes could reach the Central Plain. Suiyang commanded Songzhou and the Bian-Chen corridor and sat exactly on the throat of that traffic. Hold Suiyang and the rebels could not cut the Tang court off from the wealth of the south; take Suiyang and they could sweep west toward Bian and Chenli and south toward Xuzhou. Yin Ziqi therefore threw his weight against Suiyang, and Ningling, the screen on his western side and the doorway for Tang relief columns, was bound to be contested. On the Tang side, with the emperor fled west and the provincial governors each holding armed men and waiting to see, distant relief armies did not come, and that is what left Suiyang to face a great enemy with a handful of men.
impact: 睢陽守軍以孤城拒大軍逾十個月，客觀上為唐廷換來了最需要的東西：時間。叛軍既不能盡略河南江淮，就無法把長安的統治坐穩；朔方軍得以在河中完整重編，肅宗得以在靈武站穩，迴紇兵得以入援，兩京收復的時間表才排得出來。寧陵這一線的拉鋸同樣卡住叛軍西向汴陳、北向徐泗的擴張腳步，使尹子奇無法把兵力鋪開；此役之後，叛軍攻勢由盛轉衰，多線戰場同時收縮。更深一層看，睢陽的陷落暴露了唐廷州縣兵力的虛實：府兵制崩解之後，募兵成為唯一可行之制，卻又立刻受制於各地節度使的私兵，亂後藩鎮割據的種子就在這一年埋下。張巡、許遠殉城之後，睢陽立廟崇祀，宋代列入忠義傳，其事跡由地方祀典一路寫入正史。睢陽守城之法亦成為後世兵書援引的範例，圍城中的糧秣調度與城防布置，都被目為守城要術。
impactEn: A lone city holding a great army for more than ten months bought the Tang court the one thing it most needed, which was time. Because the rebels could not sweep Henan and Jianghuai, they could not make their rule of Chang'an stick; the Shuofang army had time to be rebuilt intact at Hezhong, Suzong had time to consolidate at Lingwu, and the Uighur troops had time to arrive, so a timetable for retaking the two capitals could be drawn up at all. The seesaw along the Ningling line equally pinned down the rebel thrusts west toward Bian-Chen and north toward Xu-Si and kept Yin Ziqi from spreading his forces; after this, the rebel offensive turned to the defensive across several fronts at once. More deeply, the fall of Suiyang exposed the emptiness of Tang district-level defence: once the fubing system had collapsed, recruited soldiers were the only workable arrangement, and those troops were at once in the hands of the personal forces of the provincial governors, so the seeds of the fanzhen separatism that followed were sown in that year. Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan were honoured with a shrine at Suiyang after their deaths, the cult was entered into the Song loyal biographies, and their story passed from local ritual into the official histories.
result: 至德二載（757）十月，睢陽城破。張巡、許遠、南霽雲等死守至最後，叛軍得城之後，士卒疲蔽、糧道拉長，而官軍主力並未受損，攻守之勢自此易位。九月官軍進軍收復西京，年底進取東京洛陽，叛軍退回河北；安祿山於次年正月為其子安慶緒所弒，戰事再拖數年，廣德元年（763）史朝義自盡，亂平。寧陵一線的結果，則是城垣殘破、守軍耗盡，縣境兵禍連綿，直至官軍收復河南之後方漸復置編制；寧陵之縣建制未廢，惟城防與兵額大損，俟兩京收復、河南平定之後，編制方告恢復，縣境重歸唐室節度使之治。就全局而言，此役的結局是：叛軍得了睢陽卻失了進取的節奏，官軍失了睢陽卻換得反攻的起點。須說明的是，寧陵一場的交戰細節、雙方指揮官與斬獲數字，舊唐書與資治通鑑均未專門記載，諸說並存，較可靠的只有其時序與地理位置兩點。
resultEn: In the tenth month of 757 Suiyang fell. Zhang Xun, Xu Yuan, Nan Jiyun and the rest held to the last; the rebels took the city but found their soldiers exhausted and their supply line stretched, while the main Tang army was unharmed, and the initiative passed the other way. The Tang forces entered the Western Capital in the ninth month and took the Eastern Capital, Luoyang, at the end of the year, and the rebels withdrew north. An Lushan was killed by his son An Qingxu in the first month of the following year; the war dragged on for several more years, until Shi Chaoyi killed himself in Guangde 1 (763) and the rebellion was over. On the Ningling line the result was a shattered wall and an exhausted garrison, with fighting spreading through the district until the Tang recovery allowed the commanderies to be re-established. In the whole war the outcome was this: the rebels gained Suiyang but lost the rhythm of the offensive, while the Tang lost Suiyang and gained the starting point of the counterattack. It should be added that the Old Book of Tang and the Comprehensive Mirror give no separate account of the fighting at Ningling, with no detail of the opposing commanders or the losses on either side; the accounts differ, and the only points that can be relied on are its place in the chronology and its position on the map.
